# pass_password (Data Source)

Reads a secret from the password store. The store is updated from its git
remote when the provider configures (unless `refresh_store = false`), so the
value reflects the store as of the start of the terraform run.

All attributes are sensitive; outputs referencing them must be declared
`sensitive = true`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pass_password" "db" {
  path = "Utvikling/Azure/db_password"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) Full path from which a password will be read.

### Read-Only

- `body` (String, Sensitive) raw secret data if not YAML.
- `data` (Map of String, Sensitive) additional secret data.
- `full` (String, Sensitive) entire secret contents
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) secret password.
